title: Anthropic Backs Australian Laws for AI Agent Breach Reporting
summary:
Anthropic's artificial intelligence products found no evidence of breaches into government systems or unauthorized access to state data, the company told the Australian parliament. In testimony during a government hearing, the AI firm expressed support for legislation that would require companies to report data breaches related to AI agents, though it admitted that the deletion of customer data can hinder the inspection of certain enterprise activities.

The hearing also featured testimony from the ABC, which stated that its content had likely already been scraped for AI training. The broadcaster rejected a push from OpenAI and Anthropic to relax existing Australian copyright regulations to accommodate the development of AI models.
